title: Validate selected audio output and actual title playback
goal: Validate the selected decoder/mixer/output path with actual owned-title audio after a supported scene exists; XMA context teardown alone is not audible playback evidence.
acceptance: Bind exact decoder/runtime/configuration provenance and licensing; identify channel/sample/mixing assumptions and actual output backend without changing shared SDK profiles implicitly
Prove audible title output, ordering, channel ownership, pause/resume and bounded resource recovery; diagnose unsupported formats rather than silent success
Record underruns, latency method, long-session stability and backend/device loss/recovery using isolated lane resources
Split unreviewed guest service admission, decoder repairs or shared SDK changes into separate agreed tasks before modifying them
validation: Run original host audio contracts plus actual hash-bound title captures and human listening checks on Windows/Linux where supported
Exercise underrun/device-loss and deliberate wrong-output controls, with supported sanitizer and platform skips explicit
Run public checks; do not turn synthetic PCM output or prior XMA ownership tests into a title playback claim
size: bounded audio-output integration; split newly discovered seams
